label: RV-EV-03
command_argv:
set -e; python3 - <<"PY"
import hashlib,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
base=Path("docs/05_任务交接/P9_PRODUCT_AUTHORITATIVE_TRACE_MINIMUM_CONTRACT_V1/evidence")
manifest=json.loads((base/"immutable_manifest.json").read_text())
missing=[]; changed=[]
for p,h in manifest["files"].items():
    path=Path(p)
    if not path.exists(): missing.append(p); continue
    actual=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    if actual!=h: changed.append((p,h,actual))
print("protected_files",len(manifest["files"]))
print("missing",missing)
print("changed",changed)
print("head",subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],text=True).strip())
assert not missing and not changed
